<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition-EC standoff:</strong> Opposition MPs were detained by police after protests demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar escalated, following a dispute over the venue for a requested meeting with the Election Commission.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPYTFMVlpsczhtNVZZNUV6V0EwYmZwenpOTGN0ZC0wb19HOE0zUXZDaEozcnJaYjl2SGN6SHBXdkh5YkN0NVNGcWJWVkloZHZ6clp1MHRjb3A4ajViUUJvOXRxelAwVXdoZFBYcmZSbHdPOVpBbVdLYXk0Y0lPckdxLTJrcVhNMktjdC0wNlpCLVhMVmZjM0Z3NTRfZXJzNFc1eUsyblk3eTBHLU1mXzNKbkxuT0U?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legal challenge in Punjab:</strong> The Punjab government has moved the Supreme Court to challenge a CBI investigation into a &#x27;bribe syndicate&#x27; allegedly linked to Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Cabinet lauds leadership:</strong> The Union Cabinet passed a resolution commending Prime Minister Modi’s governance, specifically highlighting his role in elevating India to the world&#x27;s fourth-largest economy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political rhetoric on EC:</strong> The BJP has dismissed opposition allegations against the Election Commission as a diversionary tactic, asserting that the Congress party is responsible for its own electoral losses.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxPdXFpb044MUNCNW13NjYwMVVXMU9aaFZyNUVOTHplYmY5Rjl4QlJtM0RNZ3l1cGQyZ0JGUzRnQXgyeUJhN3ViSWlPV3ZpZVBYa0hyVHpmV2I5LXdLUzJwb2FNZXlkNXN5QzVJWVNqS0RuN2NWU1NSMllEYUd6MlRGQlg5a0pfeVBKY29YaWdPUGZTQ0l0R1N5RUpHdXhVSF9kU25iZ2RYMEEwRFRmV3VNQWRiaTZTeDlWaklsNkVaT2g?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
